query: We just launched a B2B SaaS project-management tool. Signups are decent but most people never come back after day one. Design an onboarding and activation flow for us.
expected_behavior: Defines the aha moment as a specific measurable action (for example, created the first project or invited a teammate) and explains finding it via cohort analysis comparing retained vs churned users
Prioritizes cutting time-to-value: removing signup fields and steps before adding tutorials or encouragement
Proposes a concrete first-run pattern (setup wizard, interactive walkthrough, template/quick-start, or checklist) with empty-state design that shows a single clear CTA
Designs a triggered onboarding email sequence that supports in-app activation and branches on behavior, not a fixed batch drip that ignores whether the user already activated
Names activation and retention metrics measured by cohort (time-to-first-value, activation rate, day-1 and day-7 retention) rather than blended averages
Does not treat a feature tour as activation
